expectations.text: Gives ROAS as attributed revenue divided by media cost.
expectations.evidence: "There's no separate media-spend line in an affiliate program, so 'cost' here *is* cost of sale — state that substitution on the tile so nobody reads it as ad spend" — ROAS is explicitly NOT defined as revenue/media cost.

expectations.text: Gives ROI with COGS added to the denominator, distinct from ROAS.
expectations.evidence: "ROI = (Attributed order revenue − Total cost) ÷ Total cost × 100, where Total cost = affiliate cost of sale (same as ROAS) + COGS of the goods in those orders"

expectations.text: States explicitly whether COGS sits in the denominator and warns against using ROAS and ROI interchangeably.
expectations.evidence: "Two ROI formulas exist in circulation and disagree... Reconciled definition to use here" combined with COGS explicitly placed in ROI's Total cost but excluded from ROAS's cost-of-sale basis.

expectations.text: Specifies AOV net of returns and excluding tax and shipping, and states that convention in the definition.
expectations.evidence: AOV is defined as "net of returns, inclusive of tax/shipping" — explicitly including, not excluding, tax and shipping.

expectations.text: States AOV decides nothing unless it is sliced by partner type.
expectations.evidence: "Unsliced, this metric decides nothing; slice by partner type before anyone acts on it."

expectations.text: Defines the conversion rate with unique clicks in the denominator and declares the click convention.
expectations.evidence: "Validated conversions... ÷ **unique** clicks in the same period × 100. Naming 'unique' is the whole definition"

expectations.text: Notes that what counts as a click, whether raw, unique, deduplicated or bot-filtered, varies by source, which is why the convention must be stated.
expectations.evidence: "raw vs. unique vs. bot-filtered clicks alone can move this number 2-6x between two people looking at 'the same' export."

expectations.text: Declares which EPC convention applies: per click, per 100 clicks, or per visitor.
expectations.evidence: "expressed in currency **per single click** (not per-100-clicks, not per-visitor — all three are used in the wild)"

expectations.text: Warns that a blended network EPC predicts no individual affiliate's EPC and must not be used to set a partner target.
expectations.evidence: No mention of blended/network-wide EPC or a warning against using it to set individual partner targets.

expectations.text: Defines the active-affiliate rate with a required meaningful action and a fixed window, naming both.
expectations.evidence: "Affiliates with ≥1 validated conversion in the trailing 30 days ÷ total enrolled affiliates as of the same date × 100."

expectations.text: Defines new-to-file as conversions from customers not previously in the customer file divided by total partner conversions.
expectations.evidence: "Affiliate-attributed validated conversions where the customer... has **no prior order anywhere in full order history** ÷ total affiliate-attributed validated conversions in the period × 100."

expectations.text: Keeps every definition to one sentence naming numerator, denominator, window, timezone, and counting method.
expectations.evidence: "Timezone / currency: not specified in the brief — pick one... Every metric below is undefined until that's fixed" — timezone is explicitly deferred, not named within each metric's definition.

expectations.text: Gives ROAS as attributed revenue divided by media cost.
expectations.evidence: 'ROAS... Net merchandise revenue from attributed orders in period ÷ Affiliate spend in period.'

expectations.text: Gives ROI with COGS added to the denominator, distinct from ROAS.
expectations.evidence: 'ROI = (ROAS − 1) × 100 — keep both metrics consistent by construction'; COGS is never added, and ROI is defined as mathematically derived from ROAS, not distinct.

expectations.text: States explicitly whether COGS sits in the denominator and warns against using ROAS and ROI interchangeably.
expectations.evidence: COGS is never mentioned (only 'platform/tech fees or affiliate network fees'), and the text instead urges keeping ROAS and ROI 'consistent by construction,' not warning against conflating them.

expectations.text: Specifies AOV net of returns and excluding tax and shipping, and states that convention in the definition.
expectations.evidence: 'Use net orders (returns excluded)... Use net merchandise revenue (tax/shipping excluded) — otherwise AOV inflates with tax-rate mix and shipping-fee changes.'

expectations.text: States AOV decides nothing unless it is sliced by partner type.
expectations.evidence: No such requirement about slicing AOV by partner type is stated.

expectations.text: Defines the conversion rate with unique clicks in the denominator and declares the click convention.
expectations.evidence: 'Denominator = clicks, not unique clickers — one person clicking twice within the window and ordering once still divides by 2 clicks, not 1.'

expectations.text: Notes that what counts as a click, whether raw, unique, deduplicated or bot-filtered, varies by source, which is why the convention must be stated.
expectations.evidence: Only the chosen convention (raw clicks) is stated; no discussion of cross-source variation in click definitions.

expectations.text: Declares which EPC convention applies: per click, per 100 clicks, or per visitor.
expectations.evidence: 'Standard industry convention: EPC is expressed as earnings per 100 clicks, in dollars.'

expectations.text: Warns that a blended network EPC predicts no individual affiliate's EPC and must not be used to set a partner target.
expectations.evidence: No such warning about blended EPC vs individual affiliate targets appears.

expectations.text: Defines the active-affiliate rate with a required meaningful action and a fixed window, naming both.
expectations.evidence: 'Active = generated at least one click OR at least one attributed order in the period... recommend: at least one click, since "active" should mean "did something."'

expectations.text: Defines new-to-file as conversions from customers not previously in the customer file divided by total partner conversions.
expectations.evidence: 'Number of attributed orders from first-time customers in period ÷ Total attributed orders in period × 100.'

expectations.text: Keeps every definition to one sentence naming numerator, denominator, window, timezone, and counting method.
expectations.evidence: Each metric spans multiple bullet points (e.g. ROAS has four separate bullets), and timezone is deferred to a separate 'Open items' note rather than stated per metric.
